rows.backtranslation: This PNG has another image, not one of the animation images. AN Paint will open this image, not the animation images. Save creates a nonmoving image.
rows.context_and_review_note: Exact-base ImportSelection.kt:90-95: a known multi-frame PNG with pngDefaultImageSeparate receives this message rather than the first-animation-frame message. Retained functional explanation: a separate image not belonging to the animation, and that image is opened instead of animated frames. Default is explained operationally rather than given a potentially misleading first-frame label. Saving yields a nonmoving image. The translation does not claim source frames are deleted or that animation survives.

rows.context_and_review_note: Exact-base ImportSelection.kt:102 displays this only in the PDF page chooser. PdfCodec.kt:14-15 specifies raster import at 144 dpi (two source pixels per PDF point); :84 calls PdfRenderer.Page.render. Retained pages rendered as images and text/vector shapes converted to pixels. Feminine plural page agreement and mixed-subject plural conversion reviewed. vector remains an intentional technical borrowing; the wording does not promise selectable text, editable vectors, or original-PDF modification.
